simple.meaning: צְדָקָה (tsᵉdâqâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “rightness (abstractly), subjectively ( rectitude ), objectively ( justice ), morally ( virtue ) or figuratively ( prosperity ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 159 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 15:6. Its contexts include family, righteousness, commandment, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְדָקָה (H6666).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צְדָקָה (tsᵉdâqâh) / H6666 is traced through Genesis 15:6, Genesis 18:19, Genesis 30:33, Deuteronomy 6:25 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6666. tsedaqah צְדָקָה 157 noun feminine righteousness ; — absolute ׳צ Gen 15:6 +81 t.; construct צִדְקַת Deut 33:21 +5 t.; suffix צִדְקָתִי Gen 30:33 +, etc.; plural צְדָקוֺת Isa 33:15 +3t.; construct צִדְקוֺת Judg 5:11 +; suffix צִדְקֹתֶיךָ Dan 9:16 , etc.; — 1 righteousness , in government: a. of judge, ruler, king: || משׁפט Isa 5:7 ; 9:6 ; Amos 5:7 ; 6:12 ; וצ ׳משׁפט 2Sam 8:15 , עשׂה David executed justice and righteousness = 1Chr 18:14 , compare 1Kin 10:9 2Chr 9:8 ; Jer 22:3 , 15 ; 33:15 ; Ezek 45:9 ; ׳בּצ כִּסֵּא יִכּוֺן Prov 16:12 , compare Isa 54:14 ; הצ ׳מַעֲשֵׂה השׂ, ׳עֲבֹדַת 32:17 , compare V:16; צ ׳נֹגְשַׂיִךְ 60:17 . b. of law , || י ׳צִדְקַת משׁפטים, Deut 33:21 . c. of Davidic king, Messiah , || משׁפט , Psa 72:1 ; 72:3 ; Isa 9:6 ; Jer 23:5 ; 33:15 . 2 God's attribute as sovereign Psa 36:7 ; 71:19 ; in government, וצ ׳משׁפט עשׂה 99:4 ; Jer 9:23 ; administering justice Job 37:28; punishment Isa 1:27 ; 5:16 ; 10:22 ; 28:17 ; Dan 9:7 ; vindication of his people Micah 7:9 . 3 righteousness , in a case or cause, החזקתי בצדקתי Job 27:6 on my righteousness I hold fast ; צ עוד לי ישׁ ׳מה 2Sam 19:29 what right have I yet ? of God's judgments, צ ׳הגיד Isa 57:12 (iron.); צ ׳השׁיב 1Sam 26:23 ; Job 33:26 ; השׁיב ׳כּצ, 2Sam 22:25 , גמל 22:21 , נתן 1Kin 8:52 2Chr 6:23 . 4 righteousness = truthfulness , ובצ ׳באמת Isa 48:1 ; Zech 8:8 ; in word Isaiah 45:28; Isa 63:1 , oath Jer 4:2 . 5 righteousness , as ethically right: Gen 30:33 (J) Deut 6:25 ; Isa 33:5 ; 41:18 ; Ezek 14:14 , 20 ; Prov 10:2 ; 11:4-5 , 18 , 19 +17 t., + (ה)צַדִּיק(יםׅ צִדְקַת Isa 5:23 ; Ezek 18:20 ; 33:12 ; ׳צ ישׁרים Prov 11:6 ; צ ׳אֹרַח 8:20 ; 12:28 ; צ ׳דֶּרֶךְ 16:31 ; צ ׳עשׂה do righteousness Psa 106:3 ; Isa 56:1 ; 58:2 ; Ezek 18:22 ; וצ משׁפט ׳עשׂה 18:5-6 t. Ezekiel; צ ׳עשׂה ומשׁפט Gen 18:10 (J) Prov 21:8 ; צ ׳רדף 15:9 ; 21:21 ; ובצ באמת ׳הלך 1k 3:6 ; (ל)צ לוֺ ׳חשׁב Gen 15:6 (JE) imputed to him ( for ) righteousness , Psa 106:31 ; ׳צ וָחֶסֶד Prov 21:21 (twice in verse) (strike out ᵐ5 A B Toy). 6 righteousness as vindicated, justification, salvation , etc. (compare צֶדֶק 6 ): a. of God || יְשׁוּעָה תְּשׁוּעָה, יָשַׁע, Isa 45:8 ; 46:13 ; 51:6-7 t. Isa 2 ; || בְּרָכָה Psa 24:6 ; || נַחֲלָה Isa 54:17 ; || חֶסֶד Psa 36:11 ; 103:17 ; צ ׳שֶׁמֶשׁ Malachi 3:20 sun of righteousness (with healing); ׳י ׳בִּצ, delivers, guides, exalts his people 5:9 ; 31:2 ; 71:2 ; 89:17 ; 119:40 ; 143:1 ; 143:11 ; בְּצִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ אַליָֿבאֹוּ 69:28 (of wicked); as accusative after verbs of declaring, etc., his saving ( delivering ) righteousness Psalm 22:32; 40:11 ; 51:16 ; 71:15 ; 71:16 ; 71:24 ; 98:2 ; 145:7 ; also צ ׳יִוָּדַע 88:13 ; לָעַד ׳צ עֹמֶדֶת his righteousness endureth for ever 111:3 ; compare 119:142 . b. of people , = prosperity , || עשׁר הון, Prov 8:18 ; לצ ׳מוֺרֶה early rain for prosperity Joel 2:23 . 7 plural righteous acts: a. of God Judg 5:11 (twice in verse); 1Sam 12:7 ; Micah 6:5 ; vindication of right Psa 103:6 ; redemptive Isa 45:24 ; Dan 9:16 . b. of man's moral conduct Isa 64:5 ; Jer 51:10 , also probably Ezek 3:20 ; 18:24 ; 33:13 (Kt singular) Psa 11:7 (? gloss), Dan 9:18 ; as adverb accusative, צְדָקוֺת הֹלֵךְ Isa 33:15 .
